chip.description: Sample-playback and stereo-spatialization sound processor: an AT&T DSP16A core running mask-ROM QSound firmware (Capcom part DL-1425).
chip.notes: Decision guide Q2 (a signal-processing engine driven by the host CPU) fires before the audio sub-guide, so this files as dsp rather than sound-pcm; the implementation burden is exactly §4.3's — a microcoded DSP whose firmware must be reproduced.
